facts.text: The dessert is locked in a vault in Langley. Give me ten minutes and a harness, and nobody touch the floor.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Ethan's words, but he never says it. The Langley vault break in is real (he is lowered on a wire), but the line is menu copy. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source. Kept as a signed note it fits the plot.
facts.fix: Dessert is in the vault at Langley. Give me ten minutes and a wire, and nobody touch the floor.
